notes.title: Original Soundtrack Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44572924/67130a2f09424ddf864357bbe9171aedf0551739.png[/img]

Thank you for enjoying TENSEI!
Today, we have released the original soundtrack of TENSEI!

In addition to various BGM in the game, unused sound sources are included as bonus tracks.
We hope you will enjoy the soothing sounds outside the game as well!


We look forward to your continued support of TENSEI.

Project Pegasus

notes.title: TENSEI on Steam Deck
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44572924/475c87e3da3d1c5d85b3626db62e5cfbb0fd4553.png[/img]

Thank you for enjoying TENSEI!
Some of you have been asking for information regarding TENSEI compatibility with Steam Deck.
Although not yet officially verified by Valve, the ProjectPegasus development staff has confirmed that TENSEI works fine on Steam Deck!

We hope you will enjoy the relaxing Zen world on Steam Deck as well!

Project Pegasus

notes.title: Update is now available.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44572924/2998cbb2db8b5631586ed09e14d7181423031062.png[/img]
Thank you for enjoying TENSEI!
We have released an update today.

[h1]Rrelease notes[/h1]

[h2]- Additional languages supported[/h2]
　Korean has been added to the system language.

[h2]- Bug Fixes[/h2]
　Fixed a bug that caused damage determination to be invalid under certain conditions.

We look forward to your continued support of TENSEI.

Project Pegasus

notes.title: Update is now available.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44572924/14b21dd98935d4414dbb8b81d628584405d3d16d.png[/img]

Thank you for enjoying TENSEI!
We have released an update today.

[h1]Rrelease notes[/h1]

[h2]- Additional Achievements[/h2]
　New achievements, including hidden achievements, have been added.

[h2]- Improved environmental visuals and added direction[/h2]
　Various placements were added in the field and reactions were implemented when interacted with.
　In addition, minor improvements have been made to the existing placement and presentation.
　Visitors can enjoy an even more immersive experience while leisurely flying around in the tranquil space.

[h2]- Adjusted stage configuration from certain heights and above.[/h2]
　Modifications were made to landscape changes after 30,000 m altitude.

[h2]- Defects addressed[/h2]
　Several display and behavior issues were fixed.


We look forward to your continued support of TENSEI.

Project Pegasus

notes.title: We are preparing to implement additional achievements...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44572924/c3c27bb47149363191b1ed54b1c640363a6ec1a2.png[/img]

You are currently seeing new achievement information on TENSEI's Steam page,
These are in the development and testing phase of additional updates,
You will not be able to unlock these achievements with the application in release.

The additional achievements in testing will be unlocked in the next update.（5/24 17:00(JST))
Please wait for a while until the next update is released!

Project Pegasus
